title: Northrop Grumman's corporate security as an enforcement arm

tellings.quote: I I they seem to have been given um for some time now the the authority to to implement uh program security through their corporate security forces

plain: Northrop Grumman, a large American defence contractor, seems to have been given the authority some time ago to enforce the secrecy of classified programmes through its own corporate security guards. This comes from Matthew Brown, a Pentagon whistleblower who speaks as someone who saw it from the inside, in his interview with Jesse Michels. If true, it would mean a private company, not the government, is policing who learns what about some secret programmes.
